+import { createFileRoute } from '@tanstack/react-router'
+import { Marketplace } from '~/components/Marketplace'
+import { getCatalogFn } from '~/server/functions'
+import type { CatalogSearch } from '~/types/market'
+
+export const Route = createFileRoute('/')({
+  validateSearch: (search: Record<string, unknown>): CatalogSearch => ({
+    model: typeof search.model === 'string' ? (search.model as CatalogSearch['model']) : 'all',
+    category: typeof search.category === 'string' ? (search.category as CatalogSearch['category']) : 'all',
+    sort: typeof search.sort === 'string' ? (search.sort as CatalogSearch['sort']) : 'featured',
+    query: typeof search.query === 'string' ? search.query : '',
+    favoriteOnly: search.favoriteOnly === 'true' || search.favoriteOnly === true,
+  }),
+  loaderDeps: ({ search }) => search,
+  loader: ({ deps }) => getCatalogFn({ data: deps }),
+  component: MarketplaceRoute,
+})
+
+function MarketplaceRoute() {
+  const catalog = Route.useLoaderData()
+  const search = Route.useSearch()
+  return <Marketplace catalog={catalog} search={search} />
+}
*** End Patch
